content.comment_body: Hello, I've set up a connection between [article_no] and a [product_name] panel. The connection itself works, but when I run an online test and change a parameter from the HMI, the link between my PC and the [product_name] controller drops (although the HMI and controller remain connected). It shows an error message, which makes debugging the program difficult because I can't monitor program status during these changes. Thank you!

[user_name], this isn’t a fault! You have different versions of the program: the one currently running in the [product_name] controller has changes you've made online, so it's not synchronized with the one in your PC. Make sure to apply the same changes to your PC project and then retry. If you can't figure out the difference, try using online vs. offline comparison (Ctrl + Minus). Good luck!

My issue is needing to view a PI trend, but changing the SP or Gain via the HMI causes me to lose visibility. Since I can't modify Network Inputs, I'm unable to adjust the offline program for these parameters.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face issues maintaining a stable connection between their PC and the [product_name] controller during online testing, especially when making parameter adjustments from the HMI. Although the HMI and controller remain connected, losing PC access interrupts debugging and real-time monitoring. This is especially problematic when tracking process trends or adjusting variables, since program visibility and parameter changes can't be handled simultaneously.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want to monitor and debug the [product_name] program from their PC in real time, even while changing parameters via the HMI, without losing the connection between the PC and the controller.
